reason: $49 to $59 a month is a lot on $48k when the zoo and the library are free. I would not commit to a membership for a place I have never seen.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Up to age 5 is a big spread, and I do not see anything that keeps the little ones separate.
would_change_my_mind: A separate baby area or set baby-only hours, plus a free trial visit or a drop-in at $8 or less.
